textureProcessing: Existing CC0 PBR maps, 512px packed copies; diffuse chroma removed and warm mineral tint baked to image pixels. Physical planar UV tile 1.6 m. No moss or grass diffuse in underground layers.

scenes.coordinateConvention: Blender Z up, front cut face Y=-1.5; glTF exported Y up. Groundwater vertical units are conceptual with an explicit scale break.
scenes.geometryStatus: Illustrative alluvial-style soil, not a measured profile. Approximate boundaries 0.39, 1.13 and 2.02 m vary smoothly. Illustrative wheat/fibrous roots and planting density; no cultivar or future growth claim.

scenes.coordinateConvention: Blender Z up; glTF Y up. Groundwater vertical scale is conceptual with a scale break.
scenes.geometryStatus: Illustrative unconfined groundwater, conceptual 0–20 m vertical scale with demo table at 7 m. Enlarged pore openings, mineral grains, water films and fine fractures explain porous material; they are not measured porosity, a site-specific horizon, water storage or field depth. No aquifer dynamics or recharge prediction. No free underground pool.
scenes.runtimeWater: Named detailed water meshes use a user-controlled clipping plane in the browser; no inferred water depth.
scenes.wetDisplay: Blue wet saturation is an illustrative display color: Blender poster uses the default 7 m plane; browser uses the selected plane, preserving mineral luminance/normal detail.

browserReview.renderer: Headless Chromium WebGL; single rendered frame, not a device FPS benchmark
